question: Point D, E and F all lie on the circumference of a circle with centre O. If angle DEF = 48°, then what is a possible value of angle DOF?
solution:
Given:

The points D, E and F lie on a circle with centre O.

∠DEF = 48° 

Concept used:

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

Calculations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21de908d0ca037f3fb8bc5d0b0f09f830b5e85451f31d6a9d9e1f5c313fbfa3f.png] 

According to the concept,

2∠DEF = ∠DOF

⇒2(48°) = ∠DOF

⇒∠DOF = 96°

Hence, The measure of the ∠DOF = 96°.
